news.title: Atlanta homeowner hospitalized after fire; police investigate call
news.summary: A homeowner was hospitalized for smoke inhalation after a house fire overnight on Kirkwood Avenue in East Atlanta, while police investigated a separate shooting call in northwest Atlanta.

news.title: Two people injured in shooting on Courtland Street
news.summary: Two people were injured in a shooting early Sunday near 201 Courtland St. NE in downtown Atlanta, police said.

news.title: Passenger charged after rideshare driver shot in Atlanta
news.summary: A passenger was charged after allegedly shooting a rideshare driver during a dispute Saturday evening in southwest Atlanta, police said.

news.title: VIDEO: Man wanted in 18 police cases arrested after being chased, Tased
news.summary: An Atlanta man wanted in connection with 18 police cases is now in custody after officers tracked him down and chased him on foot, according to police.

news.title: Cartersville Police welcome new K-9 officer trained to detect drugs
news.summary: The Cartersville Police Department has a new four-legged officer joining its ranks.

news.title: Man sentenced to prison after fraudulently getting $1.25M in car loans, COVID relief
news.summary: A Fayetteville man will spend nearly three years in federal prison after admitting to fraudulently obtaining more than $1.2 million through pandemic relief programs and auto loan schemes.

news.title: Georgia school resource officer builds connections with students through ‘Cooking with a Cop’
news.summary: A Henry County school resource officer is finding a new way to build trust with students — one recipe at a time.

news.title: Police investigate Sunday morning shooting in Southwest Atlanta
Atlanta Police investigate overnight shooting in Downtown Atlanta
Family and friends call for justice for teen killed by police in Stockbridge
news.summary: Tyrie Howse, 16, was shot and killed by a Henry Co. Police officer Tuesday evening, according to GBI.

news.title: Family honors aspiring nurse killed in Henry County police shooting
news.summary: Friends and family of Tyrie Howse are demanding justice after a Henry County police officer shot and killed the 16-year-old during a confrontation off Highway 138.

news.title: Villa Rica shooting that sparked fatal standoff allegedly tied to homicide
news.summary: A shooting that left a man injured and sparked a deadly SWAT standoff on Conners Road is connected to an earlier murder on the same Villa Rica street, according to the Douglas County Sheriff's Office.

news.title: Woodstock woman convicted in near-fatal 2022 home birth
news.summary: A Woodstock woman has been convicted of practicing medicine without a license after a home delivery left a mother near death from severe blood loss, according to prosecutors.

news.title: Man convicted of killing unarmed victim eating outside Morrow supermarket
news.summary: A Clayton County jury has convicted a man of murder after he shot and killed an unarmed man who was eating outside a Morrow supermarket, prosecutors announced.

news.title: Search for second suspect after shooting injures 2 at Atlanta apartments
news.summary: Atlanta police are asking for the public's help to identify a second shooter after stray bullets pierced two southwest Atlanta apartments and struck two women inside earlier this week.
